_readme.what: Hand-picked template block swaps that are not part of a scan (TemplateBlockSwaps, same format as meat_block_swaps.json). Hand-written; positions read from the template nbt in the named jar.
_readme.entries: template id -> [{pos: [x, y, z] in the template, from: block id there now, to: block state}]
_readme.waystones: The glowstone under the village waystone (Waystones 11.4.2 village/common and village/desert waystone pieces, 1 block each at [2, 0, 3]) becomes Quark yellow corundum (structures/contents #9, plan_small_fixes_1116.md R16). Worldgen's waystone ruin reuses the common piece.
